note: Private RV campground beside the Four Mile Old West living-history town, 4 mi west of Custer on US-16 in the Black Hills. A gravel grid of 70-ft pull-throughs on open prairie; monthly campers get the full-hookup pads, other pads use the dump station. Passport America park. No campfires and no playground or pool. --Claude
summary: Operator pages (+2025 Wayback dating $45) + Hipcamp (unbookable) + Google + imagery: ~17 70-ft pull-throughs, 50 A + water, sewer on monthly pads only, $45 and up nightly by phone, monthly $650+, store/laundry/dump/WiFi. Under the price gate. Long-stay: 'We do a lot of monthly rentals' but sells nightly; imagery shows a mostly empty grid. Booking platform phone (Hipcamp not bookable); fees dated 2025.
flags: LONG-STAY (reviewer's call, keep recommended): operator says 'We do a lot of monthly rentals' and 'Come stay a few days or the whole summer', but leads with daily rates ('$45 daily and up', call to reserve) and puts monthly campers on the full-service pads; imagery shows 4 RVs on ~17 pads. No wording discourages nightly guests; nightly share not measurable from any source beyond that.

PRICE GATE: cheapest RV night $45 (operator, 'and up', dated 2025-08-21 capture and live 2026-11-21) - under $50. Summer peak not published ('and up', call for prices); passes unless the peak 'and up' is well over $50 - phone the only way to know. Passport America (50% off) not counted for the gate.
GOOGLE: 4.1 stars, 297 reviews, but the place is 'Four Mile Old West Town Museum' - town and campground share one listing; no separate campground rating exists.
